title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper, and no real orders are placed anywhere in it. The engines' own state is read from the running record, and the snapshot used here was read at 2026-11-13T09:03:03.302Z. A single trade says nothing about a strategy. The record is live and changes as new closes arrive, so what follows is a snapshot rather than a conclusion. It is not a forecast, and it is not a recommendation. Paper signals only.

## Live starts and the first closed trade

Live starts are counted from 1 October 2026 for trend-daily-v005 and from 9 October 2026 for trend-daily-v006. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM later exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. These are paper signals only, so no capital was at risk in the record. The ATOM exit rule was an exit below the 10-day low. The measurement was an exit at 1.703 against an entry at 2.066. The record shows the result, not the reason for the move. The ATOM result is one closed trade, and one closed trade cannot describe an engine.

## Open positions

NEAR has been open since 12 October 2026 at 5.896. The engine snapshots list 0 positions open on paper for htf-rsi-v007, 0 for trend-daily-v005, and 0 for trend-daily-v006. The record contains both facts. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, while the engine snapshots show 0 positions open on paper. The open count is part of the running state, and it can change with the next close. The NEAR entry remains open in the record, and the 0 open positions in the engine snapshots describe engine state, not a judgement on NEAR.

## Engine snapshots

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper, 6 closed trades so far, and an average of -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper, 7 closed trades so far, and an average of -13.34% net per trade. The Bitcoin market filter is off for both trend-daily engines. In testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The averages are net per trade. They are small-sample measurements: 4, 6, and 7 closed trades. A small sample can move sharply with another trade. That is why the record is unproven and inconclusive at this size.

## Market filter and breakout distance

With the Bitcoin market filter off, the trend-daily engines show 0 positions open on paper. The closest names to their 20-day breakouts are AVAXUSDT at 7.69% below its high, TRXUSDT at 10.39% below its high, and BNBUSDT at 13.54% below its high for v005; and AVAXUSDT at 7.69% below its high, TRXUSDT at 10.39% below its high, and JUPUSDT at 11.47% below its high for v006. These distances are measurements from the record, not forecasts. They describe how far each name is from its 20-day high, not what will happen next. The 20-day breakout distances are below-high percentages. They are measurements, not signals. The filter state is reported as off, and the open position count is 0.

## Where to check

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The record updates continuously, and this article reports it as it stands, with no projection. The performance page, the signal log, and the channel status post the same numbers. If they differ, the record has changed. Paper signals only.
